reviews.x: This Gown does its' job, keeping hair off me while getting a haircut. My wife likes the velcro which holds the gown securely in place around the neck and l like the fabric. It's not plastic so it doesn't get hot underneath and it's not cloth so the hair doesn't stick to it and shakes off easily. Great gown.

My wife and I have gone through a couple of cuts with this, and this exceeded our expectations. It doesn't feel stiff, but it also feels like it will last a while. I was expecting something that felt like a tarp, but this is surprisingly silky. For 5 bucks I certainly wasn't expecting this!
Very nice. Large. Covers well. Decent material. Not thin and plasticy or heavy and plasticy. Doesn't make you sweat, and yet seems tough.
For the price, you really can't beat the deal.  The cape is of very good quality, and as you might expect, has velcro to tie around the neck.  It was exactly what I was looking for.
The item shipped quickly and in excellent condition, it's light weight material makes it comfortable and because it covers fully less hair on the client
this haircutting gown is very lightweight which makes it much more comfortable to wear and easy to fasten. Reccommended for anyone who cuts hair.
its plastic and black, should last awhile as long as you treat it nice. very thin, china made. Good price but could be better.
Works well, it's made well and was very cheap. I've used it multiple times and it's as good as any.

I have used this once on myself, and it is a very nice product.  The cut hair slides right off the cape.  It is much better than a plastic bag and using a large towel.  Around the neck, it is somewhat larger than neck.  However, capes are suppose to be that way; the person cutting the hair needs the additional area to work with the machine and razor.  Those who have received a haircut from a professional certified barber know what I am talking about.  Nonetheless, it also has the right covering

reviews.t: Makes a fabulous super-hero cape...but don't tell the bad guys.
reviews.x: I was in need of a new super hero cape, and while this isn't your traditional cape, it does the job nicely.  Not only am I cloaked in darkness for my late-night super hero adventures, but it can also double as a haircutting gown, thus helping to conceal my secret identity.  Stray hairs don't stand a chance against this cape, and with my super-hero powers, the world is a better, safer place - one haircut at a time.  You're welcome.

Works fine.  It doesn't go all the way around the back, but it goes pretty far.  Velcro seems decent, but will probably wear out prematurely.  But, it was cheap, so I'll just get another one.  One other thing - I bought this thing and forgot that I did.  It took SO LONG to arrive (from China), I was nicely surprised when it came.  Then, the nice surprise wore off and remembered how long this thing took to come.  Wow.

reviews.t: Good size, does a great job.
reviews.x: I love the material and the hair just slides right off. I am not a big fan of the clasp, and it seems pretty tight to my guys. It works great though, and they did not have marks on their necks from it or anything. I have used it over a wheelchair, and it covered the majority of it. This replaced the plastic one that came with the clippers. Works a lot better and is higher quality.

reviews.t: Should be no stars. Absolutely not what I order ...
reviews.x: Should be no stars.  Absolutely not what I order.  I ordered an adult size with Velcro neck. It was advertised as a light weight breathable material.  I got a child size with a clip neck which was so small that I could not close it.  It was made of a thin poly that I was afraid to unfold in case it might tear.  Amazon... this was a dud.

The size is fine but the velcro attachment for the neck is too large. If you have the neck of the green giant it would work. I sewed on some more velcro for better attachment and it works fine. It's sad when people who make these never try them on themselves to see if they fit. I gave it four stars for the price and for mostly working.

Everything is almost perfect about this especially its texture. Hairs DO NOT stick to this cape.  Only thing it can use is some comfort where you attach it around the neck. Easy fix is to put a small rag, towel, or even paper towels around ones neck then attach the cape.  I like it a lot and my pops loves the haircuts I give him ; )

The velcro strips were so short and set so far apart that the neck line could wrap around my waist before the velcro strips met to secure itself.. I had to remove it, add more velcro and readjust where to glue down the velcro strips on the neck line.. However, the material of the cape itself is good, so that's what really matters.

I give frequent haircuts to my family members and had been using a stupid plastic cape that came in a clipper set. This is miles ahead of that! The velcro is in the right place and most of the hair slides right off.  You will need to give it a good shake out once the hair gets perfectly dry as some will stick just a little...

I like the fabric of the cape.  It's lightweight, but not too light.  The neckband is elastic.  (I didn't realize that's what I was getting.)  And, the clasp at the neck is a flimsy, lightweight metal hook.  I'm not impressed with that.  I'm keeping it because it was cheap, but I'll never order this again.

reviews.t: Does exactly what it is designed for but...
reviews.x: It just struck me that nothing I've purchased of any worth in some time now was made at home... Not even a barber's cape...... Anyway, it does its job so I can can't knock it for that and my attitude over everything seemingly being manufactured elsewhere is the sole reason for the loss of one star.  :(

I took a chance when I ordered this product as the reviews were mixed.  The neckline was elastic with rough edges. There is no way to comfortably wear this around the neck while getting a haircut or any other service. The quality of the fabric was nice. but totally unusable for my purposes.

There's not much to say about this product, other that it functions. The material is just right to keep hair off of your clothes and it is large enough to fit most people's needs. The price is just right for this product and is well worth it if you need one of these.

reviews.t: perfect for the at home hair cut!
reviews.x: The plastic version of this that came with my husband's hair cutting kit was about torn  to pieces.....to the extent that I'd been putting a trash bag over him for hair cuts. If I'd know this existed earlier I would have bought one long ago. Works great!!

reviews.t: Excellent quality! It is better than I expected which ...
reviews.x: Excellent quality! It is better than I expected which is always a plus. My only issue is the fastening piece on the neck, wish it was velcro because it would hold in place better. Other than that, I would give this a 5 * for great quality.

I guess it's OK, at best. It is very cheap and basically covers one's clothing, but the clip for the neck closure leaves a lot to be desired. I think Velcro or a snap would be better. I don't know if I'd buy it again or not.

reviews.t: I think it may work better for a small child
reviews.x: This is too short and awkward to use.  I think it may work better for a small child, but for a grown man it really misses it's mark. Hair gets everywhere and I stopped using it because it didn't make much of a difference.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the material for letting hair slide off easily and not sticking.
Many customers find it lightweight, comfortable, and not hot or sweaty to wear.
Several reviewers consider it good quality and a great value for the low price.
The velcro neck closure is a common concern, with some finding it too large or likely to wear out.
A few reviewers report sizing or shipping problems, including receiving a child size or a long wait from China.
